record.bible_text: And the word<WH01697> of the LORD<WH03068> came unto me, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>,
Son<WH01121> of man<WH0120>, set<WH07760><WTH8798> thy face<WH06440> toward the mountains<WH02022> of Israel<WH03478>, and prophesy<WH05012><WTH8734> against them,

And say<WH0559><WTH8804>, Ye mountains<WH02022> of Israel<WH03478>, hear<WH08085><WTH8798> the word<WH01697> of the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069>; Thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069> to the mountains<WH02022>, and to the hills<WH01389>, to the rivers<WH0650>, and to the valleys<WH01516>; Behold, I, <FI>even<Fi> I, will bring<WH0935><WTH8688> a sword<WH02719> upon you, and I will destroy<WH06><WTH8765> your high places<WH01116>.

And your altars<WH04196> shall be desolate<WH08074><WTH8738>, and your images<WH02553> shall be broken<WH07665><WTH8738>: and I will cast down<WH05307><WTH8689> your slain<WH02491> <FI>men<Fi> before<WH06440> your idols<WH01544>. <RF>images: or, sun images<Rf>

And I will lay<WH05414><WTH8804> the dead carcases<WH06297> of the children<WH01121> of Israel<WH03478> before<WH06440> their idols<WH01544>; and I will scatter<WH02219><WTH8765> your bones<WH06106> round about<WH05439> your altars<WH04196>. <RF>lay: Heb. give<Rf>

In all your dwellingplaces<WH04186> the cities<WH05892> shall be laid waste<WH02717><WTH8799>, and the high places<WH01116> shall be desolate<WH03456><WTH8799>; that your altars<WH04196> may be laid waste<WH02717><WTH8799> and made desolate<WH0816><WTH8799>, and your idols<WH01544> may be broken<WH07665><WTH8738> and cease<WH07673><WTH8738>, and your images<WH02553> may be cut down<WH01438><WTH8738>, and your works<WH04639> may be abolished<WH04229><WTH8738>. <RF>images: or, sun images<Rf>
And the slain<WH02491> shall fall<WH05307><WTH8804> in the midst<WH08432> of you, and ye shall know<WH03045><WTH8804> that I <FI>am<Fi> the LORD<WH03068>.<CM>

Yet will I leave a remnant<WH03498><WTH8689>, that ye may have <FI>some<Fi> that shall escape<WH06412> the sword<WH02719> among the nations<WH01471>, when ye shall be scattered<WH02219><WTH8736> through the countries<WH0776>.

And they that escape<WH06412> of you shall remember<WH02142><WTH8804> me among the nations<WH01471> whither they shall be carried captives<WH07617><WTH8738>, because I am broken<WH07665><WTH8738> with their whorish<WH02181><WTH8802> heart<WH03820>, which hath departed<WH05493><WTH8804> from me, and with their eyes<WH05869>, which go a whoring<WH02181><WTH8802> after<WH0310> their idols<WH01544>: and they shall lothe<WH06962><WTH8738> themselves<WH06440> for the evils<WH07451> which they have committed<WH06213><WTH8804> in all their abominations<WH08441>.

And they shall know<WH03045><WTH8804> that I <FI>am<Fi> the LORD<WH03068>, <FI>and that<Fi> I have not said<WH01696><WTH8765> in vain<WH02600> that I would do<WH06213><WTH8800> this evil<WH07451> unto them.<CM>

Thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069>; Smite<WH05221><WTH8685> with thine hand<WH03709>, and stamp<WH07554><WTH8798> with thy foot<WH07272>, and say<WH0559><WTH8798>, Alas<WH0253> for all the evil<WH07451> abominations<WH08441> of the house<WH01004> of Israel<WH03478>! for they shall fall<WH05307><WTH8799> by the sword<WH02719>, by the famine<WH07458>, and by the pestilence<WH01698>.

He that is far off<WH07350> shall die<WH04191><WTH8799> of the pestilence<WH01698>; and he that is near<WH07138> shall fall<WH05307><WTH8799> by the sword<WH02719>; and he that remaineth<WH07604><WTH8737> and is besieged<WH05341><WTH8803> shall die<WH04191><WTH8799> by the famine<WH07458>: thus will I accomplish<WH03615><WTH8765> my fury<WH02534> upon them.

Then shall ye know<WH03045><WTH8804> that I <FI>am<Fi> the LORD<WH03068>, when their slain<WH02491> <FI>men<Fi> shall be among<WH08432> their idols<WH01544> round about<WH05439> their altars<WH04196>, upon every high<WH07311><WTH8802> hill<WH01389>, in all the tops<WH07218> of the mountains<WH02022>, and under every green<WH07488> tree<WH06086>, and under every thick<WH05687> oak<WH0424>, the place<WH04725> where they did offer<WH05414><WTH8804> sweet<WH05207> savour<WH07381> to all their idols<WH01544>.

So will I stretch out<WH05186><WTH8804> my hand<WH03027> upon them, and make<WH05414><WTH8804> the land<WH0776> desolate<WH08077>, yea, more desolate<WH04923> than the wilderness<WH04057> toward Diblath<WH01689>, in all their habitations<WH04186>: and they shall know<WH03045><WTH8804> that I <FI>am<Fi> the LORD<WH03068>. <RF>more...: or, desolate from the wilderness<Rf><CM>
